title: Actress Akansha Chauhan Opens Up About Divorce from Gaurav Kansara
summary: Actress Akansha Chauhan has spoken about her divorce from actor Gaurav Kansara, citing irreconcilable differences. The couple's relationship was marked by controversy, with Rakesh Bedi and Netizenz taking sides. The news has sparked a heated debate in the entertainment industry.
summary_points: Akansha Chauhan has announced her divorce from Gaurav Kansara
The couple cited irreconcilable differences as the reason for their split
